channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: 3 new David Attenborough shows coming to BBC to mark 100th birthday celebrations
item.description: The BBC will mark Sir David Attenborough’s 100th birthday in May with new documentaries, classic series, and a live Royal Albert Hall event.

item.title: I tried Lakeland's bread maker with sales 776 percent up and here's my honest review
item.description: I was keen to know why the Lakeland White Compact 1lb Bread Maker was trending - two dozen easy, fresh homemade loaves later I know exactly why

item.title: North Wales arsonist who set blaze that killed pensioner found guilty of murder
item.description: Andrew Gorrell, from Saltney, was found guilty of murder after setting a bin fire that blocked the Edwards family’s only escape route, leaving 76‑year‑old John Edwards fatally injured.

item.title: Councillors question consultant spending as £3.2m ‘unused depot’ costs resurface
item.description: Calls for tighter oversight were made as councillors challenged how conwy council hires external consultants, following revelations that over £700,000 was spent on advice linked to the unused Mochdre HGV depot.

item.title: New Wales Air Ambulance airbase consultation begins after alternative site ruled out
item.description: Residents have raised objections citing potential noise, impact on tranquillity, and the encroachment into open countryside.

item.title: Search for teenager not seen for a week who may have travelled to Llandudno Junction
item.description: The teenager, known only as Alisia, has been reported missing from Blaenau Ffestiniog.

item.title: RECAP- A55 Vehicle fire prompts road closures and congestion in area
item.description: A vehicle fire has started on the A55 between J31 Prestatyn and J32 Holywell on the eastbound carriageway. Road closures are in place.

item.title: Luxury North Wales hotel goes from zero to 5-star food hygiene with new kitchen team
item.description: On October 16, inspectors noted 19 serious breaches at the Marian Resort and Spa in Dyserth, including a "large number" of flies.

item.title: Llandudno discount store running 10p clearance sale as it undergoes refit
item.description: B&M home store and garden centre, situated on Mostyn Champneys Retail Park, remains open while undergoing the refit.

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor arrested for 'misconduct' at Sandringham Estate
item.description: Reports say that Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has been arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office.
